notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One (posted jokingly as 'The Hyperdrive's Gone/I'll Be Damned'), Tatooine: City Outskirts, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer, Podrace Prep, Credits Will Do Fine and Brisky Morning Munchen; these count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.

The title says 'Ep1' and the strategy is written for the Episode I-only environment ('in Ep1 no You Are Beaten...', 'Doesn't it always in Ep1 format?'); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Sense, Alter and Control.
Posted 'Tatooine Mos Epsa' dested Tatooine: Mos Espa as posted. The Objective deploys Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard and the strategy plays at 'the Junkyard', but no Junkyard is listed.
The post is tagged Dark, but the Objective and every card are Light; the deck is listed as Light.

Posted 'Qui-Gon's Saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, released after this post); 'Shmi's Hut' dested Tatooine: Slave Quarters (deploys Shmi); 'Marketplace' dested Tatooine: Marketplace; 'Cap'n Panaka' dested Captain Panaka; 'Padme' dested Padme Naberrie; 'Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Threepio w/ Parts Showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'I Did It' dested I Did It!; 'A Tragedy Has Occured' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred.
